import re

content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line if it's a comment
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by "
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        songs_to_archive.append((title, artists))
    else:
        # Maybe just title? But we'll assume format
        songs_to_archive.append((line.strip(), []))

print(songs_to_archive)
